=== update-ui.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "🚀 Syncing UI between local and Lovable repo (operation-dashboard-ui-07)..."

# Direction depends on FLAGS:
#   No flag: Pull Lovable changes into local (including generated codegen)
#   --push: Push local changes into Lovable (excluding gen/, which is Lovable-managed)
#   --dump-protos: Export dynamic protos from SHM blobs to Lovable before push

# Handle --dump-protos first (export SHM blobs to Lovable proto dir, then continue)
if [ "${1:-}" = "--dump-protos" ]; then
    echo "📦 Exporting dynamic protos from SHM blobs..."
    if [ -x "./target/debug/dump-protos" ]; then
        ./target/debug/dump-protos operation-dashboard-ui-07/proto/ 2>&1 | grep -v "already written" || true
    else
        echo "⚠️  dump-protos not compiled - run 'cargo build -p op-grpc-bridge --bin dump-protos' first"
    fi
    echo "✅ Dynamic protos exported to operation-dashboard-ui-07/proto/"
    echo "🚀 Now pushing to Lovable..."
    # Continue to push
fi

LOVABLE_DIR="${LOVABLE_DIR:-/home/jeremy/git/operation-dashboard-ui-07}"
LOCAL_UI_SRC="crates/op-web/ui/src"
LOCAL_UI_PROTOS="crates/op-web/ui/proto"
LOVABLE_SRC="$LOVABLE_DIR/src"
LOVABLE_PROTOS="$LOVABLE_DIR/proto"

if [ "${1:-}" = "--push" ]; then
    # Push local edits TO Lovable (hand-edited source only, not generated)
    echo "📤 Pushing LOCAL source → Lovable repo..."
    rsync -av --delete "$LOCAL_UI_SRC/" "$LOVABLE_SRC/"
    mkdir -p "$LOVABLE_PROTOS"
    rsync -av "$LOCAL_UI_PROTOS/" "$LOVABLE_PROTOS/"
    # Also sync dynamic plugin protos from op-grpc-bridge target/debug
    if [ -d "crates/op-grpc-bridge/proto" ]; then
        rsync -av "crates/op-grpc-bridge/proto/" "$LOVABLE_PROTOS/../" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    # Sync plugin_methods from dump-protos output (if exists)
    if [ -d "target/debug/proto/plugin_methods" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$LOVABLE_PROTOS/plugin_methods"
        rsync -av "target/debug/proto/plugin_methods/" "$LOVABLE_PROTOS/plugin_methods/" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    for f in index.html components.json tailwind.config.ts postcss.config.js \
             tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json \
             vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json; do
        [ -f "crates/op-web/ui/$f" ] && rsync -av "crates/op-web/ui/$f" "$LOVABLE_DIR/$f"
    done
else
    # Default: Pull Lovable changes INTO local (including generated codegen)
    echo "📥 Pulling LOVABLE changes → local source..."
    rsync -av "$LOVABLE_SRC/" "$LOCAL_UI_SRC/"
    mkdir -p "$LOCAL_UI_PROTOS"
    rsync -av "$LOVABLE_PROTOS/" "$LOCAL_UI_PROTOS/"
    for f in index.html components.json tailwind.config.ts postcss.config.js \
             tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json \
             vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json; do
        [ -f "$LOVABLE_DIR/$f" ] && rsync -av "$LOVABLE_DIR/$f" "crates/op-web/ui/$f"
    done
fi

echo "🏗️ Building UI (op-web serves from static dir immediately)..."
npm run build --prefix crates/op-web/ui

if [ "${1:-}" = "--push" ]; then
    pushd "$LOVABLE_DIR" >/dev/null
    git add -A
    git commit -m "Sync from local op-web/ui source (auto)" || true
    git push origin zeroclaw
    popd >/dev/null
    echo "✅ Pushed to Lovable GitHub."
else
    echo "✅ Pulled and built. Local op-web now serves updated UI."
fi

# ZeroClaw — Native Operator Console

Native Rust GUI built on `eframe`/`egui`. Mirrors the layout, navigation, and theme of the web operator console while talking directly to the ZeroClaw core over **tonic + tonic-web** with **server reflection**.

## Run

```bash
cargo run --release
# point at a remote core:
ZEROCLAW_GRPC=https://op.local:443 cargo run --release
```

## Architecture

```text
.zeroclaw/
├── Cargo.toml
└── src/
    ├── main.rs        # eframe entry + background tokio runtime
    ├── app.rs         # topbar + sidebar + routed shell
    ├── nav.rs         # NAV_GROUPS port (1:1 mirror of React nav)
    ├── theme.rs       # graphite/slate dark theme tokens
    ├── grpc.rs        # tonic-web client + ServerReflection bootstrap
    ├── schema.rs      # schemars Schema → egui renderer (schema-as-code)
    └── views/mod.rs   # per-route views (Inspector/State/gRPC are schema-driven)
```

## gRPC + reflection

`grpc.rs` opens a `tonic::transport::Channel` (works for both native gRPC and
`tonic-web` proxied endpoints), calls `ServerReflectionClient::server_reflection_info`,
and loads every returned `FileDescriptorProto` into a `prost_reflect::DescriptorPool`.

From the pool we can:

- enumerate services + methods (rendered in the **gRPC Diagnostics** view)
- decode any response payload into `serde_json::Value` via `DynamicMessage`
  (`grpc::decode_to_json`)

Server side (in `op-web`) needs:

```rust
let reflection = tonic_reflection::server::Builder::configure()
    .register_encoded_file_descriptor_set(zeroclaw_proto::FILE_DESCRIPTOR_SET)
    .register_encoded_file_descriptor_set(tonic_health::pb::FILE_DESCRIPTOR_SET)
    .build_v1()?;

Server::builder()
    .accept_http1(true)
    .layer(tonic_web::GrpcWebLayer::new())
    .add_service(reflection)
    .add_service(/* your services */)
    .serve(addr).await?;
```
